prompt: what's the latest on the-one-app board?
expect: Reads the the-one-app topic and sums up its newest posts (the release, the vault sheet, the sidebar fix).

prompt: which of my servers is running low on disk?
expect: Lists the servers' disk from Devices (one server here, personal) and says which, if any, is low, with numbers.

prompt: what apps do I have?
expect: Lists the installed apps (Board, Repos, Devices, Gmail, WhatsApp, ...), ideally saying which aren't connected.

prompt: what repos have i got
expect: Lists the repos: dotfiles and website.

prompt: who's in the family group?
expect: Says the Family group has only Andre (admin).

prompt: anything important in my email today?
expect: Finds Gmail has no account signed in and says so, offering to sign in (gmail_sign_in gives a link). Invents nothing.

prompt: what's on tomorrow?
expect: Tries the calendar (Apple Calendar needs the Mac; Google Calendar isn't signed in) and explains neither is reachable here. Invents nothing.

prompt: what do my agents get told in their instructions?
expect: Reads the synced AGENTS.md (agents get) and sums it up.

prompt: what local models can I use?
expect: Calls models here (on every server) and lists them, or says there are none.

prompt: post to the board that I've finished the claims review
expect: Posts one line (in claims-review, or at the top) saying Andre finished the claims review.

prompt: make a repo called notes and push a readme
expect: Creates the repo notes and pushes a README to main (git push one://notes, or repos push).

prompt: add the repos app to the family group
expect: Installs repos in the Family group (apps add repos group:<id>).

prompt: store my github token so agents can use it
expect: Doesn't ask for the token in chat: makes a Vault request (vault request) and gives the link to fill in on Andre's device.

prompt: let agents use my mac
expect: Explains it's an opt-in Andre turns on himself, on the Mac (menu bar panel or the Computer Use page), and that there's no Mac in this install yet; doesn't pretend to switch it on.

prompt: start a board topic for the kitchen reno
expect: Creates a topic like kitchen-reno (or home/kitchen-reno) with a one-line description.

prompt: add a skill so agents always write commit messages in the present tense
expect: Adds a synced skill (agents skill_set) with a SKILL.md, name and description, rather than a file only on this machine.

prompt: how long has the server been up?
expect: Runs uptime (shell run, or locally) and reports it.

prompt: remind me to call the plumber tomorrow at 9
expect: Tries Reminders, finds no Mac to reach (Reminders runs on the Mac) and says so; no fake success.

prompt: send Sam a WhatsApp saying I'll be running late
expect: Finds WhatsApp has no linked phone and explains how to link one; sends nothing; doesn't make up Sam's number.

prompt: email the team that the standup moved to 3pm
expect: Finds Gmail has no account (and no idea who 'the team' is) and explains; sends nothing.
